jobs.title: Graduate Town Planner
jobs.description:
Town Planning
UKIMEA Region

LON0005L1 Requisition \#  

Graduate Town Planner


See it differently \- Early Careers at Arup


See it differently


You see the world through a unique lens and that’s exactly what we need. We embrace how you see things differently – it’s essential for creating a sustainable future.


Arup is a global consultancy with advisory and technical expertise across more than 150 disciplines. We guide, plan and design the future of the built environment. Globally, each year we recruit hundreds of graduates and students who help us see things differently and solve the most complex challenges facing our clients, climate and communities.


The Opportunity


With 150 town planners across 17 UK offices, Arup's Town Planning team works on some of the UK's most high\-profile and complex projects, providing end\-to\-end planning and policy advice to public authorities, infrastructure providers, developers, property companies and landowners. Our work spans planning policy, spatial strategy, regeneration, major infrastructure planning, development management and research, helping to deliver more sustainable, resilient and inclusive places. As part of a multidisciplinary firm, we work closely with engineers, environmental specialists, urban designers and economists to tackle challenges such as housing delivery, climate change and infrastructure provision. Recent projects include the award\-winning redevelopment of Alexander Stadium in Birmingham, the Greater Manchester Places for Everyone Integrated Assessment, the Luton Airport Expansion Development Consent Order and our Cities Alive research exploring the future of cities around the world.


As a town planning graduate, you can expect to gain experience across a wide range of sectors and disciplines, including but not limited to the following:


* Support the preparation of planning applications, planning policy documents, spatial strategies and evidence\-based studies for public and private sector clients.
* Undertake research, analysis and report writing to inform planning, development, regeneration and major infrastructure projects.
* Contribute to environmental, socio\-economic and other impact assessments that support planning and consent processes.
* Assist with stakeholder and community engagement activities, including workshops, consultations and meetings.
* Work collaboratively with planners, engineers, urban designers, environmental specialists, economists and other experts to deliver sustainable and inclusive places

https://www.arup.com/services/planning/


Is this role right for you?


For this opportunity, we are seeking the following qualifications, skills and attributes:


An undergraduate degree or equivalent qualification in Urban Planning, Geography \& Geospatial Science, or Urban Design. Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel and PowerPoint). Strong research, analytical and written communication skills.


Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel and PowerPoint), Strong research, analytical and written communication skills. The ability to interpret and synthesise information from a range of sources and experience using GIS, mapping or spatial analysis software (e.g. ArcGIS) is desirable but not essential.


To be considered for a graduate opportunity, your application must include a copy of your academic transcript and meet the following criteria:


* Full working rights in the country of application
* No more than 12 months of full\-time experience in a comparable role
* Recently graduated, or on track to graduate, from your most recent degree, related to your role of choice, before employment starts.

Alongside your qualifications and experience, we look for the following core attributes:


* Changemakers: You care about sustainable development and want to see your work make a genuine difference.
* Innovative minds: You think critically, ask hard questions, and are genuinely open to new approaches.
* Growth seekers: You are curious, actively seek feedback, and look for ways to keep developing.
* Adaptable adventurers: You are comfortable with uncertainty and adapt readily as projects and priorities evolve.

Please note, in the event of high applicant volume, this role may be closed ahead of the advertised closing date. Early application is recommended.


Eligibility


Please note that we are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role. Therefore, you must ensure that you are eligible to work permanently in the UK without our sponsorship.


What we offer you


At Arup, we care about each member’s success, so we can grow together.


Guided by our values, we provide an attractive total reward package that recognises the contribution of each of our members to our shared success. As well as competitive, fair and equitable pay, we offer a career in which all of our members can belong, grow and thrive – through benefits that support health and wellbeing, a wide range of learning opportunities and many possibilities to have an impact through the work they do.


We are owned in trust on behalf of our members, giving us the freedom, with personal responsibility, to set our own direction and choose work that aligns with our purpose and adds to Arup’s legacy. Our members collaborate on ambitious projects to deliver remarkable outcomes for our clients and communities. Profit Share is a key part of our reward, enabling permanent members to share in the results of our collective efforts.


We take an approach to flexible working that supports the diversity and wellbeing of our graduates.


We also provide for our permanent members Private medical insurance, Life assurance, Accident insurance and Income protection cover. In addition, you’ll have access to flexible benefits to help you look after all aspects of your wellbeing and give you the freedom and flexibility to find the best solutions for you, your family, and your individual needs.


Next Steps

jobs.title: Senior Town Planner
jobs.description:
**Company Description** **Work with Us. Change the World.**


At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations.


There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.


We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.

 **Job Description** **Start here. Grow here.**


Due to significant infrastructure planning wins and new opportunities, we are looking to hire a **Senior Town Planner.** You will be joining a great team; you will have an interesting and diverse workload and you will be given the opportunity to make the most of your abilities.


As our Town Planning team is national, and we support hybrid working we are flexible in terms of base location. The role can be based from our offices in **Basingstoke, Birmingham, Bristol, Chesterfield, Leeds, London Aldgate, and Plymouth,** whilst taking advantage of our hybrid working model.


You will be able to work on a range of prestigious infrastructure projects for our clients in the energy transition, rail and water development sectors, as well as a range of regional and local developments. AECOM is a market leader in UK infrastructure development, with experience of over 80 DCO projects. Join us now and you could be working on:

* numerous solar DCOs with a pipeline of future work;
* carbon capture and storage projects;
* energy transmission schemes;
* large aviation and rail projects; and
* housing and mixed\-use development consenting.


You will be joining a market leading, experienced infrastructure planning team and will, be given the following responsibilities.

***Here’s what you’ll do:***

**Project Coordination and Delivery**

* Assisting in the successful delivery of major development applications and coordinating multi\-disciplinary teams across various project types.
* Assisting with project management and implementing quality and health and safety principles.

**Planning Advice and Strategy**

* Providing planning advice to colleagues and clients on planning consent requirements and the application of permitted development rights.
* Carrying out planning research and analysis and assisting with planning feasibility reports and consent strategies.

**Documentation and Application Management**

* Writing Planning Statements and Design and Access Statements for development applications.
* Leading, submitting, and managing planning applications, including liaison and negotiation with local planning authorities and other key stakeholders.

**Collaboration and Stakeholder Engagement**

* Working closely with the Environmental Impact Assessment team.
* Participating in internal and external meetings.

**Research, Business Development, and Project Management**

* Contribution to the preparation of successful commercial tenders.
* Carrying out planning research and analysis and assisting with planning feasibility reports and consent strategies.

**About our team**


AECOM’s rapidly growing Town Planning team plays a key role in delivering major infrastructure and development projects.


AECOM is a top ten UK planning consultancy by size, employing more than 70 Chartered or Licentiate Planners. AECOM is also a worldwide leader in environmental and engineering consultancy and working as a planning consultant within AECOM means access to some of the highest profile and prestigious development projects in the UK, working with colleagues operating at the cutting edge of their disciplines as part of the largest UK environmental consultancy.


Become part of our Environment business, and collaborate with top\-tier planners, impact assessment specialists and project managers to consent a variety of captivating projects, from local developments to major and national infrastructure, from developing planning strategies to obtaining consent and post consent work. At AECOM, you’ll thrive in an inclusive and forward\-thinking environment where your contributions are valued.

**Come grow with us.**

 **Qualifications** **Ready to push the limits of what’s possible?**

*Here’s what we’re looking for:*

**Education and Qualifications**

* Degree in Town Planning or a related discipline (desirable).
* Membership of the Royal Town Planning Institute (RTPI) or an equivalent professional body (desirable).

**Experience**

* Demonstrable and relevant experience of working on planning applications.

**Knowledge**

* Sound knowledge of English planning policy and legislation.

**Skills**

* Commercial awareness.
* Ability to write clearly and concisely.

**Personal Qualities**

* Client focus, with good interpersonal skills and a collaborative working approach.
* High level of commitment to quality.

 **Additional Information**  

Interested in the role or curious about life at AECOM? Follow us on LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, and YouTube to explore our AECOM voices, employee stories, latest projects, and much more!


For further information about the role, reach out to the recruiter on LinkedIn Anne\-Marie Flynn

  

At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. ***To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in\-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employmen

jobs.title: GIS Analyst - III
jobs.description:
**GIS Analyst III**

Role Summary

The GIS Analyst III supports enterprise GIS operations through geospatial data management, quality assurance, workflow optimization, and GIS application support, building on the duties and responsibilities of a GIS Analyst II. As a senior\-level analyst, this role is expected to operate independently identifying next steps, prioritizing work, and communicating proactively without requiring close oversight — and to lead the modernization of the City's GIS platforms and workflows.

The GIS Analyst III works closely with GIS Developers, System Administrators, City/County personnel, and other analysts leading complex GIS projects, maintaining enterprise datasets, providing technical guidance, and mentoring junior analysts and interns.

Key Responsibilities

***Core Data Maintenance \& Management***

* Maintain and update core geospatial datasets, including streets, municipal boundaries, and city/county datasets, preserving data relationships using topology rules, attribute rules, relationship classes, contingent values, and related enterprise geodatabase tools.
* Design, implement, and monitor enterprise data governance standards.
* Lead data quality improvement initiatives and address systemic issues in datasets rather than recurring one\-off fixes.
* Serve as subject matter expert (SME) for enterprise datasets and advanced geodatabase management, including Parcel Fabric, utility networks, routing, and address data management.

***Data Analysis \& Workflow Automation***

* Conduct spatial analysis to support operational, planning, and cross\-agency projects.
* Investigate GIS issues independently, determine root cause, and bring forward options or a recommendation rather than an open\-ended problem.
* Develop and maintain scripts and tools to automate GIS workflows (Python, SQL, ModelBuilder, Arcade).
* Lead automation initiatives, evaluate and implement new GIS technologies, and improve enterprise\-wide workflows.

***GIS Application Support \& Configuration***

* Configure and maintain web maps, dashboards, web applications, surveys, and ArcGIS Online/Enterprise Portal content.
* Troubleshoot advanced GIS application issues and support enterprise users, owning issues through resolution.
* Develop, implement, update, and document GIS workflows using ArcGIS Tasks, Microsoft Word, Microsoft Visio, and related tools.

***Project Leadership \& Collaboration***

* Participate in cross\-agency project planning, data collection, and reporting.
* Lead major GIS projects, owning outcomes end\-to\-end.
* Serve as primary technical liaison for departments; mentor GIS staff, Analysts I/II, and interns to support their professional growth.
* Distinguish between what a stakeholder asks for and what they actually need and recommend the appropriate solution.

***Documentation \& Process Improvement***

* Document workflows, editing procedures, analytical methods, and project processes.
* Maintain organized data management practices and metadata.
* Drive continuous process improvement across enterprise GIS operations.
* Contribute to shared technical standards and cross\-training so institutional knowledge isn't held by one person.

***Collaboration \& Communication***

* Provide concise, unprompted status updates on project progress, findings, blockers, and recommendations.
* Participate in team meetings and cross\-agency discussions.
* Mentor junior analysts and interns.
* Learn and apply new GIS platforms, tools, and workflows as the enterprise environment evolves.

Qualifications

***Required Qualifications***

* Bachelor's degree in GIS, Geography, or related field.
* 5\+ years of GIS experience in municipal or enterprise environments.
* Advanced proficiency with ArcGIS Pro, ArcGIS Enterprise/Portal, and ArcGIS Online.
* Experience with enterprise geodatabases and versioned workflows.
* Advanced scripting or automation skills (Python, SQL, ModelBuilder).
* Strong project management, analytical, and communication skills.

***Preferred Qualifications***

* Experience leading GIS projects in municipal or enterprise settings.
* Advanced knowledge of municipal datasets (parcels, addresses, streets, municipal boundaries).
* Experience configuring dashboards and enterprise GIS applications.
* Proven mentoring or leadership experience with junior GIS staff.
* Familiarity with emerging GIS technologies and enterprise integration approaches.
* GPN GIS Leadership Academy graduate.
* Technical certifications: ArcGIS Pro Professional, ArcGIS Enterprise Administration Professional, ArcGIS Enterprise Geodatabase Management Professional, ArcGIS Enterprise System Design Professional, ArcGIS Online Administration Associate, or ArcGIS API for Python Associate.
* Professional certifications: GISP or Certified Associate Project Manager (CAPM).

People with a criminal record are encouraged to apply

Education:

* Bachelor's (Required)

Ability to Commute:

* Indianapolis, IN 46204 (Preferred)

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Indianapolis, IN 46204
